description: A grey-hulled cargo ship with a raised bridge superstructure, a mast and a funnel, carries rows of silver-white box containers on deck and sails through choppy dark blue water. A small red-and-white tugboat follows at the right. Behind the ship, tall steel gantry cranes and a few dock lights stand on a quay under a dark, stormy sky, with smoke from another vessel at upper right. The style is loose oil-paint brushwork with no visible letters, numbers, frame or figures in focus; the hull's rusted waterline and the mid-century superstructure suggest an older freighter.
